# transparent

> HTTP API to remove image backgrounds. Send an image, get back a PNG with the background removed.

- Base URL: `http://localhost:3000` (dev) or your deployed domain
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header (only when `NITRO_API_TOKEN` is set)
- `/health` is always public (no auth)

## Docs

- [Full API reference](llms-full.txt): Complete endpoint documentation with request/response formats, error codes, and code examples in TypeScript and Swift
